lines.zh: 我迈着长腿走在草地上
lines.en: I walk the grassland on long legs.

lines.zh: 我的脖子往前伸，头很小
lines.en: My neck reaches forward; my head is small.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，步子却很长
lines.en: I do not go fast, but my strides are long.

lines.zh: 族群里其他的跟在我后面
lines.en: The rest of the herd follows behind me.

lines.zh: 我踩过一片矮草，草伏下去
lines.en: I cross low grass and it bends.
Bird-like, but I run like wind.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在空中保持平衡
lines.en: My tail balances me in the air.
We move as a loose herd.

lines.zh: 地面被我们踩出多条路
lines.en: Our feet have worn several paths.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边东张西望
lines.en: I look about as I go.
I pass the edge of a pool.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾在草上分得很开
lines.en: My toes spread wide on the grass.

lines.zh: 我停下来，让最小的那只跟上
lines.en: I stop to let the smallest catch up.
My head rides high.

lines.zh: 我站在草原中间，抬着头
lines.en: I stand in the grassland, head up.
Wind passes through my feathers.
One of the herd grazes.
My legs are thin, and so is my shadow.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，够高处的叶。
lines.en: I stretch my neck for higher leaves.

lines.zh: 远处有一片树，我看了看
lines.en: There is a stand of trees far off; I look at it.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只脚，停了一下
lines.en: I lift a foot and pause.

lines.zh: 我的脖子弯出一个弧度
lines.en: My neck curves into an arc.
I open and close my mouth slowly.

lines.zh: 一只小虫落在我的腿上
lines.en: A small bug lands on my leg.
The wind on the grassland never stops.

lines.zh: 我把一只腿的关节弯了弯
lines.en: I flex a leg joint.
I watch a cloud's shadow.
I swing my tail to the other side.
My long legs are ready to bolt.
You stand; I do not come near.

lines.zh: 我的族群往后退了几步
lines.en: My herd takes a few steps back.
I stretch my neck to look.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一丛草，互相打量。
lines.en: Across a clump of grass, we size each other up.
I lift a foot and put it back.
I raise my head above the grass.

lines.zh: 我的族群在我后面挤成一群
lines.en: My herd crowds behind me.

lines.zh: 我偏过头，确认你不是树。
lines.en: I tilt my head to confirm you're not a tree.

lines.zh: 你若走开，我们继续吃草
lines.en: If you leave, we go back to grazing.

lines.zh: 我的头小，眼睛却看得远
lines.en: My head is small, but my eyes see far.
I shift a step to the side.
I give half a step, my knees soft.
I lower my head, breathing fast.
The herd closes in slowly.
I slowly straighten up again.
I give half a step and draw my neck in.
One leg will not lift.
My breathing turns rapid.
The herd presses toward me.
I lower my head and pant.
A patch of my feathers is disordered.
Those leaves look tender.

lines.zh: 似鸟龙走得慢，六只一起。
lines.en: Ornithomimus walks slow, six of us together.
I run fast; I only wait for you to let go.

lines.zh: 我的头很小，吃不了太多
lines.en: My head is small; I cannot eat much.
One of the herd is watching me.
I lower my head slowly.
My mouth holds only one leaf.
I lift my head to swallow.
One of the herd wants to come close.
I step back to let it eat too.

lines.zh: 似鸡龙的长腿一沉，你弹开了。
lines.en: The ornithomimid's long leg dips; you bounce off.
My legs are thin; I give two steps.

lines.zh: 我低下头看你，脖子弯着
lines.en: I lower my head to you, neck curved.
We collide and I slip half a step.

lines.zh: 我轻轻避开你，脚步没停。
lines.en: I sidestep you without breaking stride.

lines.zh: 我的腿被你撞得弯了一下
lines.en: My leg bends where you hit it.
I tip sideways and hold.
The herd scatters past us.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾踩到你的鞋尖
lines.en: My toes step on your toe.
We burst a clump of grass apart.

lines.zh: 她走在我旁边，步子一样
lines.en: She walks beside me with the same stride.
Our necks cross.

lines.zh: 她替我把背上的草叶拨掉
lines.en: She flicks a grass blade off my back.

lines.zh: 我们一起朝树林那边走
lines.en: We head toward the trees together.
Her legs are even thinner than mine.
We walk side by side a long while.

lines.zh: 我们的步子自然对上了
lines.en: Our stride falls into step.
She rests her head at my neck.
We both look back at the herd.
She takes a step; so do I.
I lower my head, neck bending.
I carry a tender twig, chewing as I walk.
I lift my head and swallow it.
I lower my head for the next one.
I stretch my neck as far as it goes.
I pinch it with the tip of my beak.
I lift my head and take it in.
I search beside it.
I flick it into my mouth.
I find another leaf in the grass.
My head stops moving.
I stretch my neck further.
The herd begins to spread out.
I shift my weight to my hind legs.
I stop and raise my neck.
My herd begins to spread outward.
I shift my weight onto my hind legs.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向偏了偏头
lines.en: I tip my head your way.
I do not call; a call would scatter all.
I freeze mid-step, eyes on you.
My shadow reaches your feet.
I slowly take one step back.

lines.zh: 你站着没动，我有点好奇
lines.en: You have not moved; I am curious.
I draw my neck back halfway.
I watch while backing away.
My herd has already run off.

lines.zh: 我和他们保持一段距离
lines.en: I keep a distance from them.
I fall back to the herd's edge.
I haven't missed a single gesture.
My legs are ready to run.

lines.zh: 你进一步，我就退到树后。
lines.en: Step closer and I retreat behind a tree.
One of the herd calls out sharply.
I lift my head to find a way out.

lines.zh: 我和你之间隔着一片草
lines.en: A stretch of grass lies between us.
I edge slowly toward the trees.
I do not turn; I only back away.
The grassland is wide; I do not want to fight.
My neck stays turned to you.
You come closer; I give two steps.
I count the herd.
I lower my head a little.
I kick once.
I butt my head at you, lightly.
I kick and withdraw a step.
My legs are thin, but they kick fast.
I kick out with a forefoot.
I butt my head at you, lightly.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾在你腿上刮过
lines.en: My toes rake your leg.
I kick and retreat into the grass.
My legs are thin, but they lift high.

lines.zh: 你挡住我的脚，我改了方向
lines.en: You block my foot; I change angle.
I kick once from the side.

lines.zh: 我踢空了，自己晃了一下
lines.en: I miss and stumble.
I dip my head and kick again.
This one carries no weight.
My foot lands on your knee.
You pull back; I rejoin the herd.

lines.zh: 草原上先扬起一小片尘
lines.en: A little dust rises on the grassland first.

lines.zh: 我从高草里迈出来，脖子先探出。
lines.en: My neck emerges first from the tall grass.
The herd spreads to both my sides.
I raise my head to this land.

lines.zh: 我跑起来，像一只大鸵鸟。
lines.en: I run like a huge ostrich.
I stop, my neck straight.
I come walking from the far grassland.

lines.zh: 族群跟在我后面，拉成一条线
lines.en: The herd trails behind in a line.

lines.zh: 我的腿在草上显得很长
lines.en: My legs look long against the grass.
I stop and lift my head.
Wind stirs my feathers.
I wear a new path.

lines.zh: 影子先落在地上，我随后
lines.en: My shadow lands first; then I do.

lines.zh: 我把脖子伸长，看了一圈
lines.en: I stretch my neck and look around.
The smallest of the herd presses to me.
I come to a stop on this grass.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的羽毛，我跑得很快
lines.en: Fire singes my feathers and I run fast.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下去，腿乱蹬
lines.en: I slide down the slope, legs flailing.

lines.zh: 水没到我的腹，我伸长脖子
lines.en: Water reaches my belly and I stretch my neck up.
The blast turns me sideways.
Something is stuck in my leg.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我一时站不稳
lines.en: That force leaves me unsteady.
Not enough grass; my legs tremble.
Lightning flashes and I drop flat.

lines.zh: 地面没了，我的长腿在空里
lines.en: The ground is gone; my long legs kick air.
